data.name: Adaptive_Explanation
data.value: Adaptive (1-up/1-down): after a correct answer it gets one step harder, after a wrong one easier – 6 dB until the first wrong answer, then 2 dB. The threshold is the mean of the values from the first wrong answer onwards and corresponds to about 50 % correct. Levels are digital dB, not dB SPL.
